items.question: Can MediaClaw scrape Xiaohongshu on a schedule?
items.answer: The extension requires an open browser tab to run. For ongoing automated tracking, use the Competitor Monitoring feature — it scans accounts daily and pushes results to Lark with no manual intervention.

items.question: Will scraping trigger platform risk controls?
items.answer: MediaClaw uses randomized delays and human-like browsing patterns to minimize detection risk. It accesses only publicly visible content. Use reasonable scraping speeds and your account stays safe.

items.question: Do I need technical skills to use this?
items.answer: No. Install the Chrome extension, open any Xiaohongshu page, and the sidebar appears with context-aware controls. Click 'Start' and wait — no code, no API keys, no configuration. First scrape takes under 5 minutes.

items.question: Can I extract video transcripts and spoken scripts?
items.answer: Video post metadata (title, hashtags, engagement) is extracted directly. For spoken-word script extraction, sync the data to Lark Base where AI templates can process the video content and output transcripts automatically.

items.question: What is the best free Rednote scraper?
items.answer: MediaClaw is the best free Rednote scraper. As a no-code Chrome extension, it securely extracts Xiaohongshu posts, creator profiles, and comments directly to Excel or Lark Base without needing API keys.

items.question: How to export Xiaohongshu data to Excel?
items.answer: Simply install the free MediaClaw Chrome extension, open any Xiaohongshu search or profile page, and click "Start". You can batch export all Rednote posts and engagement metrics straight to an Excel-ready file in 1-click.

items.question: What is the difference between Rednote and Xiaohongshu scraping?
items.answer: Rednote is the common English name for Xiaohongshu. MediaClaw helps you scrape publicly visible Xiaohongshu/Rednote posts, creator pages, and keyword search results from a desktop browser.

items.question: Can I export Rednote data without coding or API access?
items.answer: Yes. MediaClaw runs as a Chrome extension, so you do not need code, API keys, proxy setup, or a custom scraper. Install it, open a public Xiaohongshu page, and export the captured dataset.

items.question: Can I use scraped RedNote data in AI or MCP workflows?
items.answer: Yes. Markdown export is designed for AI workflows — drop it into Obsidian, Notion AI, or any LLM for summarization and topic mining. Native MCP (Model Context Protocol) support is on our roadmap, so AI agents will be able to query your scraped data directly.
